selection: Use all eligible sources produced by the same deterministic sampler and seed as the initial 24-source prefix. At most two source positions per physical instance with at least 0.6m between them. This extension was selected before opening blind performance results.
input_guard: semantics and true instance pixels are used only by the sampler, teachers and evaluator; model input may use source RGB, observed goal box, source depth, physically measured left scan and candidate relative actions.
